response.overview: The Cranberries perform live at Grosse Freiheit 36 in Hamburg, Germany, on April 16, 1999, during the Bury the Hatchet era. Featuring Dolores O’Riordan on lead vocals, the concert includes performances of some of the band’s most popular songs, including “Zombie”, “Linger”, “Promises” and “Ode to My Family”.
response.title: The Cranberries: Live in Hamburg
